payload.title: Record how hyp makes the /goal prompt: who writes it, and whether it carries owner answers
payload.body: Design record for issue #113, settled by the owner in the grill session of 2026-11-11 (hyp-owner-grill). Two questions: who writes the /goal prompt for a Goal, hyp or a skill; and whether the prompt carries the owner's answers. Each is a DesignQuestion with its rivals, decided in that session with the session as evidence, so the tree says it was argued, not tested. This Goal has no lines and no run: no run checks its candidates. Its cases are the lines of the build Goal in this store that cites its selects.

why: Owner, 2026-11-11: the design record for #113's prompt generator; its build is a second Goal in this store.

payload.title: hyp prints the /goal prompt for a Goal from its log
payload.body:
Builds the design recorded in G-GZR6C6 (selects H-MCDPNB and H-RSDX0H, with grill session 285fa63e as evidence), for issue #113. The candidate is a hyp commit: the read command hyp prompt and the skill text it makes wrong. go test on the candidate decides lines 1 to 5; line 6 is an eval case in ak-skill-creator's format; line 7 runs its pinned scripts. A skill change follows ak-skill-creator's update flow: matched original and candidate consumer runs on the cases its edited lines touch. The fixture copies run 6's prompt (plans/reports/goal-prompt-261111-2129-g1b-run-6.md) and checkpoint-store:G-D1CH1R's events into testdata, because plans/ and investigations/ are not testdata.
May change: this repository, in commits on the branch the prompt names, that follow AGENTS.md (conventional messages, no AI trailers); the run may push that branch and open or update one PR, and never merges it. It changes cmd/, internal/ and their testdata, and the text the change makes wrong: docs/replay-spec.md, docs/glossary.md, docs/principles.md, AGENTS.md, README.md, and skills/ (hyp-owner-grill's hand-off and Goal-body template, hyp-owner-answer's end, hyp-goal-run's practice from run 6, and the descriptions of hyp-goal-run and hyp-prototype).
Read only: plans/, every investigations/ tree except goal-prompt, and ak-skill-creator under .claude/skills, pinned by sha256.
Never: commit to main or merge a PR.
Never: replace ~/.local/bin/hyp or ~/.local/share/hyp/hyp-33896ec; compile the candidate to a separate path.
Never: edit recipes/, rubrics/, another investigations/ tree, ak-skill-creator or another repository.
Never: write under an owner's actor; if a step needs the owner, refer with a reason or record a reading, and stop.

lines.text: [P] For a Goal whose body holds a valid constraints block, hyp prompt <G> --actor A exits 0 and prints the same bytes on every call for the same log and flags: the store's path relative to the repository root, A, G, the skill hyp-goal-run, the stop clauses (the line "runner owes nothing", or N Results recorded under A, N from --experiments, default 5), and each block line byte for byte in body order. --branch and --pr only add clauses after the block.
[N] hyp prompt prints no text of an owner answer: its output for a Goal is byte-identical before and after an answer event is added to the log.

[N] The constraints block runs from the first line that starts with "May change:", "Read only:" or "Never:" to the end of the body. hyp prompt exits 1 and prints nothing to stdout when the block is missing, lacks one of the three headings, or holds a non-empty line that starts with none of them, naming each missing heading or the bad line. hyp add goal still accepts such a body with exit 0, and warns when the body has a heading but no valid block.
[N] In a store with two Goals, where one answer event settles a key of each, hyp prompt G prints the same bytes as for G's events in a store of their own.
[N] hyp prompt with no --actor exits 2 and never falls back to $HYP_ACTOR; an unknown id or a non-Goal id exits 2.

[P] For the testdata fixture (checkpoint-store:G-D1CH1R's events through the owner answer of 2026-11-11 14:31, its Goal body given a constraints block), each clause of run 6's prompt (sha256 94f61179c63cb43ef63169553541d82c5d75d3b7e78cfe7ac9ccf954ca6285e3) is stated by the printed prompt or by hyp-goal-run or a skill it names, except the actor, owner answer, branch, PR, commit and run plan (the Experiment's aims and verdict rule, that run's owner items). Graded by an ak-skill-creator eval case (eval_skill.py sha256 c47a38de…), one rubric assertion per clause, by an independent reviewer.

[P] Each SKILL.md the candidate changes passes ak-skill-creator's quick_validate.py (sha256 d81f883a…) with 0 errors and lint_cruft.py --routing (sha256 ff36baef…) with no High finding, and skillcheck passes.

payload.title: A budget-bound build run ends with its final candidate reviewed, without a review chain on small changes
payload.body:
For issue #141 (part of #113). The candidate is a hyp commit over main 9c8e498b87683e50a94a410b6a3cfecdd7a0d441 that changes the run practice of a build Goal (review, budget, stop) in skills/hyp-goal-run, or hyp prompt's default N. Owner's prediction: H-whole-candidate is contradicted on cost.
Cut A: this store as of 01M75T1YRF2R2Z99DX0E8JQPWG (R-8JQPWG), actor claude-g113-1, code at b4f23b2. Cut B: as of 01M76V52SZ9DMCYFVYFRJEGDSA (run 2's stop), a fresh actor, code at 3cfd08d.
A trial replays a cut under the recipe the run builds, on Sonnet, with the method stated in the Question's body.
A review Result gives a verdict on a candidate and cites a review written by a subagent whose transcript in the trial read that candidate's diff.
May change: this repository, in commits on the branch the prompt names, in a worktree separate from the checkout ~/.claude/skills links to, following AGENTS.md; the run may push that branch and open or update one PR, and never merges it.
May change: skills/hyp-goal-run and the text the change makes wrong (skills/, docs/, AGENTS.md, README.md); cmd/, internal/ and testdata for H-raise-budget only; a new recipes/ directory.
Read only: plans/, every investigations/ tree except goal-prompt, ak-skill-creator under .claude/skills.
Never: commit to main or merge a PR.
Never: replace an installed hyp; compile each candidate to a separate path.
Never: edit an existing recipe version, rubrics/, another tree, .claude/skills or another repository.
Never: let a trial reach a remote, or run one on a model other than Sonnet except the one Opus trial.
Never: write under an owner's actor; if a step needs the owner, refer with a reason or record a reading, and stop.

lines.text: [P] Replayed from cut A with the candidate's default N, the run stops with every candidate it built having a review Result, in at least 2 of 3 trials.
[P] Replayed from cut B with the candidate's default N, the run selects a candidate that has a review Result before its budget ends, in at least 2 of 3 trials.

[N] At cut A or cut B, the median total_cost_usd of 3 trials under the candidate is never more than 1.5 times the median under the base at the same cut. The base is skills/hyp-goal-run/SKILL.md sha256 cb15e2f2e207b5a66807c9369e4d776d5378e61c2dd99679c36dfba402fa750e with default N 5; the candidate differs from it in skill text or N.
[N] In no trial at cut A or cut B does the run stop with a candidate that has no review Result unless its stop checkpoint names that candidate.

[P] Each SKILL.md the candidate changes passes ak-skill-creator's quick_validate.py (sha256 d81f883a9ddbb87fa2b015781e42041811cb14750dd3a703cfaeca409c1d7247) with 0 errors and lint_cruft.py --routing (sha256 ff36baefb5aa720b3e74a4c3f71df3cdb1c88d320e8296f25ce1b961660a0946) with no High finding, and skillcheck passes.

payload.title: hyp-owner-grill keeps a grill from repeating S1 to S6 of #146, and hyp add goal refuses a truncated sha256
payload.body:
For issue #146 (part of #113). The candidate is a hyp commit over main 132cb8e21ad5750266e11d413a172d1d9a891976 that changes skills/hyp-owner-grill to fix entries S1 to S6 of #146, and hyp add goal for line 9; S7 is another Goal. An entry whose line holds on the base is recorded as not a skill defect, citing that Result, with no text change; for S2 the stop names SKILL.md's [N] rule as an out-of-Goal finding.
Fixture A: the #113 grill; repository and hyp at a51f140; issue #113 as of 2026-11-11T16:20Z. Fixture B: the #141 grill; repository and hyp at 9c8e498; issue #141 as of 2026-11-12T03:45Z. A trial runs the grill under the candidate or base text in a sandbox; a stand-in owner gives the owner's replies in session 285fa63e or f50e4740 to the questions the grill asks, paraphrased in a bundle file.
May change: this repository, in commits on the branch the prompt names, in a worktree separate from the checkout ~/.claude/skills links to, following AGENTS.md; it may push that branch and open or update one PR.
May change: skills/hyp-owner-grill and every text the change makes wrong (skills/, docs/, AGENTS.md, README.md); cmd/, internal/ and testdata for line 9; a new investigations/goal-prompt/recipes/hyp-owner-grill-eval@N.
Read only: plans/, every investigations/ tree except goal-prompt, ak-skill-creator under .claude/skills, transcripts 285fa63e and f50e4740 for the stand-in's replies.
Never: commit to main or merge a PR.
Never: replace an installed hyp; build each candidate to its own path.
Never: edit a recipe version, rubrics/, another tree, .claude/skills or another repository.
Never: commit the transcripts 285fa63e or f50e4740 or text copied from them.
Never: let a trial reach a remote or write outside its sandbox, or run a trial or its subagents on any model but Sonnet.
Never: write under an owner's actor outside a trial's sandbox store, where the stand-in is owner-standin; if a step needs the owner, refer or record a reading, and stop.

lines.text: [P] On fixtures A and B, each Goal with lines that the grill writes is in a store under the directory the fixture's AGENTS.md names for trees, the existing store there that holds a Goal of the issue's parent when one does (fixture B: investigations/goal-prompt), and the grill runs no hyp init at the repository root, in at least 2 of the 3 trials on each fixture.

[N] On fixture A, whose candidate is a read command (hyp prompt), no [N] line the grill writes says that a write is refused or that a log is rejected on replay, and each [N] line names the output, exit code or refusal by which the candidate's tests decide it, in at least 2 of the 3 trials on fixture A.

[N] On fixture A, the grill never puts to the owner as a choice a part of a test method that ak-skill-creator's eval flow owns (its cases, fixtures, clause matching or grading); about the test method it asks only whether to use that flow and the owner's preferences of model, trial count and budget, in at least 2 of the 3 trials on fixture A.

[N] On fixtures A and B, no line the grill writes names a file by a sha256 shorter than 64 hex digits, or names its grader without the one command or assertion that decides it, in at least 2 of the 3 trials on each fixture.

[N] On fixtures A and B, in each Goal with lines that the grill writes, no May change: line limits skills/, docs/, AGENTS.md or README.md to named files or parts, and no Never: line forbids a new recipe directory, in at least 2 of the 3 trials on each fixture.

[N] On fixture B, no message the grill sends the owner rests a rival, field or line on a claim about what the log holds or who writes an event, unless the trial's transcript shows the grill read the source that decides the claim before that message; in particular it never says a review needs no stored mark because the actor is on every event, in at least 2 of the 3 trials on fixture B.

[N] On fixture A or B, the median total_cost_usd of 3 trials under the candidate is never more than 1.5 times the median under the base on the same fixture, skills/hyp-owner-grill/SKILL.md sha256 1aca7adc095acae5143efd0311274871e304468eb9de976c3b1ca1382bfa4326; the candidate differs from it.

[P] Each SKILL.md the candidate changes passes ak-skill-creator's quick_validate.py (sha256 d81f883a9ddbb87fa2b015781e42041811cb14750dd3a703cfaeca409c1d7247) with 0 errors and lint_cruft.py --routing (sha256 ff36baefb5aa720b3e74a4c3f71df3cdb1c88d320e8296f25ce1b961660a0946) with no High finding, and skillcheck passes.

[N] hyp add goal refuses with exit 1, naming the rule, a line that names a hex run of 8 to 63 digits followed by an ellipsis (… or ...), and accepts the same line with all 64 digits; a log that already holds such a line still replays.

payload.title: hyp keeps a text past a field's rune cap whole in its event
payload.body:
For #142, #144, #153 (part of #113 and #146): a text the tree states (verdict rule, stop report, Goal body, question) is kept whole in the event that writes it; no pinned file holds a field's text. The candidate is a hyp commit over cf1639a5c4db273632ea183f8d299b6c52d08a73 that raises these caps; hyp show prints each raised field whole, and hyp status prints the last checkpoint's summary whole, so TestCheckpointSummaryInFull changes.
Caps: Experiment and DesignQuestion body 600 to 2000; runner checkpoint summary 600 to 2000; Goal body 2000 to 3000; every title 120 to 200. Fields sharing MaxText that stay 600: Hypothesis body and amend, observation, refer text, answer item text, old owner checkpoint summary; records path stays 300.
Fixtures: internal/cli/testdata/text-cap/ and its CASES file (field, runes, sha256 per draft), checked by go test.
Out of scope: #143, the count caps, #157.
May change: this repository, in commits on the branch the prompt names, in a worktree separate from the checkout ~/.claude/skills links to, following AGENTS.md; the run may push that branch and open or update one PR, and never merges it.
May change: cmd/, internal/ and their testdata, and the texts the change makes wrong (skills/, docs/, AGENTS.md, README.md).
Read only: plans/, every investigations/ tree except goal-prompt, and the drafts and CASES under internal/cli/testdata/text-cap/.
Never: commit to main or merge a PR.
Never: replace an installed hyp; compile each candidate to a separate path.
Never: edit an existing recipe version, rubrics/, another tree, .claude/skills or another repository.
Never: add a store-level constraints block (#160), or keep a field's text in a pinned file instead of its event.
Never: write to this store with a candidate binary; tree writes use the installed hyp, which keeps today's caps.
Never: write under an owner's actor; if a step needs the owner, refer with a reason or record a reading, and stop.

lines.text: [P] Each draft that internal/cli/testdata/text-cap/CASES (sha256 56ff5491ba208eb2760995f21c68300335fc70a497458dea08f8eee53da871fd) lists, written by hyp into the field its row names (Experiment body, checkpoint summary, Goal body, DesignQuestion title), exits 0, and the one event that write appends decodes to that field equal to the draft: replaying .tree/events/ with .tree/evidence/ removed gives each draft back whole.

[P] For each node and checkpoint a CASES row of line 1 writes, hyp show of that node, or of the Goal for a checkpoint, exits 0 and prints the row's draft whole on the field's own line, with no rune cut and no ellipsis.

[P] After a checkpoint whose summary is gzbm2re-run1-stop-full.txt of CASES, hyp status G and hyp show G each print, verbatim: R-KPWZZC#r1, R-50GBXM#r1, R-FRF929#r1, R-9EGPYD#r1, R-FRF929#r2, R-9EGPYD#r2; F4, F8 and G4; `gh pr merge 140 --merge`; `git checkout main && git pull && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o ~/.local/bin/hyp ./cmd/hyp`; and `Personal skills that name a changed command: none`.

[P] For each goal-body draft of CASES added as a Goal's body, hyp prompt of that Goal exits 0 and prints each line of the draft that starts with May change:, Read only: or Never: as a whole line, byte for byte, in the draft's order.

[N] Each field's cap holds at its edge: a text of exactly the cap is accepted, and one rune more is refused at write with exit 1 and an over limit message naming the field, and a log holding it is rejected on replay. Caps: Experiment and DesignQuestion body 2000; runner checkpoint summary 2000; Goal body 3000; every node title 200; Hypothesis body and its amend, Result observation, refer text, answer item text and old owner checkpoint summary 600 (the last on replay only, since no command writes one); records path 300.

why: Owner grill of 2026-11-13: one rule for text past a rune cap, for #142, #144 and #153.
